title: CompositeDeviceEdit
description: JSON schema for the compositeDeviceEdit event

devices.description: The list of child devices that make up the composite device. At least 2 children are required. Heading must be provided. Children preserve their absolute height.

heading.description: Relative heading in the composite device.

replacesDeviceId.description: Set this when replacing an installed child device, to copy the old child device's settings.
